name: This portfolio
summary: Flutter Web compiled to WASM, content in JSON/Markdown and an architecture mode that shows how it is built.
description: A case study of this very site.

architecture.presentation: Riverpod providers that expose the use cases; they do not know the data layer.
architecture.domain: Pure Dart: entities, contracts and use cases. An architecture test checks it in CI.
architecture.data: Reads JSON and Markdown from assets/content; falls back to Spanish when a translation is missing.

decisions.title: The language comes from the URL
decisions.body: / is Spanish and /en is English. Each language has its own route branch that sets the page texts, so a shared link always opens in the language it was shared in.

decisions.title: Layer rules checked by a test
decisions.body: A test walks lib/features and fails if domain imports Flutter or presentation imports data. The architecture does not rely on discipline.

decisions.title: Content without touching code
decisions.body: Each project is a shared JSON plus one per language. Files are discovered from the AssetManifest, so adding a project means adding files.
